name: 温床织母
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original boss combat body for the 2D action RPG Abyss Salvager, abandoned-mine industrial fantasy. Premium hand-painted stylized game rendering, sculptural soft top-left light, charcoal iron, worn copper, ivory mineral edges, restrained emissive cores, broad readable forms and deliberately controlled texture. Match a coherent family of salvaged mining machinery and mineral-organic creatures, but create an entirely original boss. Camera: elevated three-quarter top-down view, looking down about 40 degrees, facing lower-right. Single full body in a grounded ready-to-fight pose. Entire body, tools and limbs visible with 10 percent clear transparent margin. Square canvas. Designed to be legible when displayed 140–180 pixels high: strong unique silhouette, few broad contrasting masses, iconic organs visible, no tiny tangled decoration. Truly transparent PNG alpha cutout, virtually opaque character interiors, narrow antialiased edges only. No background, black backdrop, gradient, floor, base, pedestal, ground shadow, scene props, text, glyphs, numbers, watermark, UI, borders, extra creatures, floating attack effects, baked warning rings or diagrams. No franchise resemblance. Subject BO02 Broodbed Weaver / 温床织母: a broad LOW organic boss with a semitranslucent layered mushroom CROWN growing over a recognisable broken industrial MINING DRILL chassis. EXACTLY EIGHT thick muscular ROOT LIMBS fan outward into an asymmetrical eight-petal rosette silhouette, all eight root tips complete and visibly separated, supporting the core without a floor. Each root is a solid broad sculptural form rather than thin tangled tendrils. The compact central drill has corroded copper ribs and one blunt broken spiral drill nose peeking toward lower-right. Large overlapping fungus-crown lobes use muted plum, damp ivory, dark ochre and a few desaturated mint bioluminescent veins; crown surface physically translucent within an otherwise solid near-opaque cutout, no see-through ghost body. Distinct pale root knots near four limb bases are visible weak parts. A sheltered pale mint-yellow heart inside the opening crown contrasts with dark woody roots. No humanoid head, no arms holding weapons, no insect abdomen. Deliberate flower-shaped boss silhouette with biomechanical mine-wreck structure, readable weight and dangerous rooted stance. No surrounding spores or external mist.
postprocessing: None; source PNG and alpha copied unchanged.
limitations: Static body artwork only; does not constitute animation or boss gameplay acceptance.

visual_inspection: Eight distinct thick root tips now visible after targeted imagegen anatomy correction; not counting the drill.
Plum fungus crown, pale mint-yellow heart and corroded drill remain recognizable; no ground, text or UI.
qa.alpha_method: System.Drawing read-only GetPixel stride4; visible alpha>16, near-opaque alpha>=240; actual outermost edges checked at every pixel. No image pixels edited.
qa.runtime_scale_validation: Shape design and source checked; actual engine-scale rendering is owned by boss runtime integration and is not claimed here.
qa.limitations: A single static body, not direction variants, phase poses, attack animation, or complete boss gameplay.

iterations.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied BO02 original transparent boss PNG. Preserve this exact premium hand-painted plum/ivory/mint fungus crown, luminous central heart, corroded copper drill chassis and broken forward drill, root texture, elevated top-down three-quarter camera and full-body industrial-fantasy identity. The ONLY design correction: give this boss EXACTLY EIGHT thick rooted support limbs with eight individually visible complete tips, arranged around the body as an eight-petal fan. The current rear root is obscured: make the eighth limb clearly emerge at the upper-left rear and extend its intact pale root-tip into the empty top-left space, while keeping the other seven existing limbs. Count eight chunky roots total, NOT eight fingers on one foot and not counting the metal drill as a root. No extra secondary root branches or additional limbs. Adjust spacing gently so roots do not merge at the outer silhouette and no root touches canvas edge; full object inside central 85 percent of square canvas. Keep genuine transparent alpha, solid body interiors, no background, floor, shadow, UI, text, extra creature or effects. Preserve all colors and materials; this is one surgical anatomy/readability improvement, not a redesign.
iterations.reason: Expose eighth root with complete separated tip while preserving crown, heart, drill and style.
